```yaml
name: OpenSSF Scorecard & License Check

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  checks: write

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  scorecard:
    name: Run OpenSSF Scorecard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'
      - uses: ossf/scorecard-action@v2
        with:
          results_file: scorecard.json
          results_format: json
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          badge: true
      - name: Upload Scorecard Badge
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: scorecard-badge
          path: scorecard.svg

  license-check:
    name: Verify SPDX License
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Check license field
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "Checking license field in all package.json files..."
          find . -name package.json -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            if ! grep -q '"license": *"MIT"' "$file"; then
              echo "❌ License not MIT in $file"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ All package.json files have license MIT"

  dependency-review:
    name: Dependency Review
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v4
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fail-on-severity: high
          fail-on-scopes: devDependencies
          comment-summary-in-pr: true
```
